title: Select None and Select All act only on the customers the search shows
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Net 30 is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 15 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly three customers, {Customer-A}, {Customer-B} and {Customer-C} (a new term holds only this case's customers), whose names are in that A to Z order, with credit limits of $500.00, $0.00 and $1,000.00.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-05 N15, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-05 Alpha, {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-05 Bravo and {Customer-C} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-05 Charlie.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Type the last word of {Customer-B}'s name in "Search customers".
  4. Click "Select None".
  5. Clear the search box.
  6. Click "Select None".
  7. Click "Select All".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens.
  • Step 3: only {Customer-B} is listed.
  • Step 4: {Customer-B} is unticked and the count reads "2 selected".
  • Step 5: all three are listed again: {Customer-A} and {Customer-C} still ticked, {Customer-B} unticked.
  • Step 6: all three are unticked and the count reads "0 selected".
  • Step 7: all three are ticked and the count reads "3 selected".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R6: “"Select All" ticks, and "Select None" unticks, every customer the search currently matches, including those not scrolled into view. Customers hidden by the search keep their ticks.”
  • S4-R2: “The window shows, top to bottom: a "Search customers" box; "Select All" and "Select None" with "{n} selected" on the right; a scrolling list of every customer on the term, A to Z, each with a checkbox; a "Move To" dropdown; and the buttons "Cancel" and "Move {n} Customers" ("Move 1 Customer" when one is selected).”
